newsitem.title: CANADA: Northstar, Morrison announce details of merger.
newsitem.headline: Northstar, Morrison announce details of merger.

text.p: Northstar Energy Corp and Morrison Petroleums Ltd on Thursday announced details of a merger between the two companies.

The companies said Morrison shareholders will receive 0.70 percent of a Northstar share for each Morrison share. The merger will be undertaken on a "pooling of interest" basis and the combined company will have a market capitalization of almost C$1.3 billion, based on pre-announcement trading prices, the company said.
Following the completion of the merger, the merged company intends to launch an issuer bid of about C$325 million to buy back its outstanding shares, the companies said.

Northstar said it expects to mail an offering circular to Morrison shareholders within the next 10 days and the completion of the offer is subject to fulfilment of certain conditions, including regulatory approval.
The merger is subject to a minimum of acceptance of the holders of 66 2/3 percent of the shares of Morrison, Northstar said.

Northstar president and chief executive John Hagg will be chief executive of the merged firm, which will continue to be known as Northstar Energy Corp, the companies said. Morrison chairman and chief executive Gordon Stollery will be the chairman of the new firm.
Under an agreement, Morrison will pay Northstar C$16.25 million if a superior proposal is made and accepted by the shareholders of Morrison, the companies said.
Morrison and Northstar have also agreed to pay a fee of C$5 million to the other company, in certain circumstances, if the merger does not go ahead.
